seo_title: Token2049 Live: Eliza, Nill and Srini Report from Singapore
meta_description: Eliza, Nill and Srini dial in from Token2049 Singapore: tokenization, social trading, security worries, Murad's meme coin keynote and why people attend.
summary: Chill Pill and R2D2 start with the week's news, including PONS listings and a Robinhood app campaign aimed at Webull customers, then bring in three guests live from Token2049 in Singapore. Eliza, Nill and Srini describe what builders and traders were talking about on the floor, from tokenization and trading data to wallet security and Murad's meme coin keynote.
takeaways: The guests say tokenization was a common thread at Token2049: teams are building all-in-one platforms that can offer stocks, commodities, gold and other assets in one place.
Social trading was very visible at the conference, with several teams competing for attention and trading events drawing crowds.
Robinhood Chain had less presence in Asia than BNB, Mantle or Solana; a guest argues that entering these markets through RWAs takes longer than a few months.
Security and quantum resilience were high on people's minds, and the guests linked that to more interest in hardware wallets and more care with phones and QR codes at events.
For the guests, the main value of a conference is networking and meeting the people behind the accounts, rather than any single announcement.
